# volcano_project_domains (Data Source)

Every custom domain attached to any frontend in a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_project_domains" "example" {
  project_id = volcano_project.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only
